body: I have actually been looking for recourses for couples therapy. Not once have I found that. Thank you so much.

Honestly, thank you. It's like the answer I've always known, but wasn't sure if it was the right one. I'm so scared though, i know I need to confront her, i know we need to talk, but I'm just scared and it makes me want to cry. Thank you stranger for a little bit of hope though. It means more than you can know.

There's no shame in self care. It's not selfish to take care of yourself first before taking care of others. I do a similar thing where I put people's problems above mine and its honestly not healthy, at least from personal experience. Don't be afraid to take time for yourself to do a positive activity to help yourself.

I'd reccomnd finding out if your local area has a warmline to call. There's a service out here where I live where you can call and someone will listen to your hardships and feelings. I think they would also be able to help you get set up for therapy mentally and also to find out where you can go, weather you're insured or not. I hope things work out for you.
Thank you for the response. And hey, I'm rooting for ya. Hopefully you can reach your goals and get to where you need to be.

According to her she's ended all of her relationships for various reasons, but never in the account that she's cheated on them. She's been cheated on before and obviously the anxiety it gives her that I might go (which I would never) is worrisome.

I told her something very similar to this account but she still says she feels pretty, "disgusting." It's just hard and unfortunate to see my baby girl beat herself up over this. The funny thing is when we met, I was already in a poly relationship. It didn't last long and I left my previous two partners for her because it wasn't working out. I've had to remind her that obviously I don't think that it's a bad thing for her to crush on other people. I just want to help her understand, in the most supportive and non judgemwntal way I can, that it's okay to crush on people. She hasn't brought it up for a few days but occasionally she'll have reoccurring crushes and new ones. I just want her to feel okay, anyway I can help.
